missing_root_module.name: od_core.py
missing_root_module.search_performed: all 12615 objects of git rev-list --all --objects, plus git ls-files --others --exclude-standard over the whole worktree

what_this_means: od_core.py is the ADAPTER between the surviving engine (edlab/substrates/lattice_bond/engine.py, blob 0980525690..., 27439 bytes, intact) and the whole Route E operator stack. The engine survives. The gate that would enlarge the eligible set survives as source text. The glue between them does not. Every module that could execute a scientific run fails on its first import line.

mutation_oracle.reason: an oracle requires an importable module; p07_core.py cannot be imported
tests_not_performed: no new RNG draw or reordering

why_not: section 3 states explicitly: 'If no independent executable size control exists: ELIGIBLE_SET_SIZE_CONTROL_NOT_EXECUTABLE. Do not implement one in this mission.' Writing od_core.py would also change the executable path away from the one that produced every inherited number, so nothing measured with it could be compared to the prior evidence.

separability_finding.question: even with a runnable stack, can |E| be varied at constant dose?
separability_finding.answer: NO, and this is measured rather than argued
separability_finding.structural_argument: the delivered quantity per event is q = min(planned, sink capacity, source capacity), where sink capacity is a sum over the eligible set. |E| therefore influences the outcome ONLY through the delivered quantity it unlocks: where the planned dose or the source binds, enlarging |E| changes nothing; where |E| binds, enlarging it necessarily delivers more material.
separability_finding.measured_confirmation: P07 07B at matched planned dose Q400 and matched t256 state, 18 blocks: PARENT -> TRACKALL raises delivered mass from 0.620 to 3.865 of M256 (x6.2) while incumbent removed FALLS from 0.460 to 0.298 and efficiency collapses from 0.744 to 0.075.
separability_finding.consequence: the section-3 requirement that the control 'change the eligible set without silently changing total dose or material quantity' cannot be met by this architecture. Independently of the missing module, the factor is ELIGIBLE_SET_SIZE_NOT_SEPARABLE_FROM_OTHER_PHYSICS.
